title: Enforcement
description: Enforcement is a 2020 Danish crime action film directed by Anders Ølholm and Frederik Louis Hviid in their feature directorial debut. The film premiered at the 77th Venice International Film Festival in the 35th International Critics' Week on 5 September 2020, and it is about two patrol officers who find themselves trapped when unrest spreads after news arrives that a young foreigner of the ghetto has died while in police custody.
